language.script_notes: English is the signage language, with Setswana widely spoken. The internet domain is .bw. The country is very sparsely populated.

road_furniture.km_marker_style: Road numbers carry the initials A or B (an 'A' road is the main route type); yellow-and-black striped poles are common. Older signs have blue backgrounds. The road surface looks rough in texture, with orange roadsides.

architecture.distinctive_building_types: Remote cattle posts and small villages far apart along endless straight roads, with wildlife crossing signs.

nature.vegetation: Sparse shrubs and grasses with few trees beside the roads; further north the vegetation becomes taller, with non-needle grasses and more plants, and the lush Okavango Delta lies in the north.
nature.terrain: Predominantly flat — around 70% of the land overlaps the Kalahari Desert — and notably flatter with fewer trees than neighbouring countries; there is no mountain terrain.
nature.climate_signature: Tropical in the north and desert climate across the rest, with semi-arid savanna and big open skies.

vehicles.plate_color: Yellow plates for ordinary vehicles, blue for public-service vehicles and taxis, and some white plates.

google_coverage.coverage_notes: Coverage follows the main paved roads; the country is sparsely populated and huge areas are uncovered.

confusion_set.shared_traits: Left-hand traffic, English signage, similar dry savanna and Kalahari edge landscapes
confusion_set.tiebreaker: The country here is notably flatter with fewer trees, plates are yellow, and yellow-and-black striped guardrails and poles are common.

confusion_set.shared_traits: Shared northern savanna and Okavango-region woodland
confusion_set.tiebreaker: The desert flatness, A- and B-numbered roads and yellow plates help separate it; compare directly.
Lesotho is mountainous, whereas this country has no mountain terrain.
